findings.highlight: there aren’t that many houses around
findings.governingReading: there are no houses around us
findings.explanation: The Emiya property’s isolation becomes a merely sparse neighborhood.

findings.evidenceJa: 近所付き合いも少ない
findings.governingReading: we have little contact with any neighbors
findings.explanation: A social relationship pattern becomes the number of people living nearby.

findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえんところの若い衆
findings.governingReading: one of the young men from Fuji-nee’s household
findings.explanation: The likely visitors’ age, gender, and group relation to the Fujimura household disappear.

findings.highlight: I don’t know why she’s mad
findings.governingReading: I have no recollection of doing anything that warrants being scolded
findings.explanation: Shirou denies any basis for reprimand; the English instead accepts Rin’s anger as fact but says its cause is unknown.

findings.highlight: carelessly goes into the living room
findings.evidenceJa: 事も無げに居間へ移動
findings.governingReading: proceeds into the living room as though it were nothing
findings.explanation: Rin’s complete unconcern becomes carelessness or poor judgment.

findings.governingReading: Caster, who has established her position at Ryuudou Temple

findings.highlight: manage to get in there by force
findings.explanation: Saber describes Archer tolerating some strain as an exception; English turns that into the physical method by which he enters.

findings.highlight: after he manages to get in there with all his might
findings.evidenceJa: 疲弊しきった体で境内にあがったら
findings.governingReading: once he reaches the temple grounds utterly exhausted
findings.explanation: The resulting exhaustion that makes Archer vulnerable to ambush disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなのいい的じゃないか
findings.governingReading: Wouldn’t that make him a perfect target?
findings.explanation: The explicit target image setting up Rin’s archer/target word reversal is replaced by generic disapproval.

findings.highlight: she will try to take us down with her
findings.evidenceJa: 私たちごと爆散しかねない
findings.governingReading: she may blow herself apart together with all of us
findings.explanation: The predicted explosive self-destruction mechanism becomes a generic mutual defeat.

findings.governingReading: just before six in the evening
findings.explanation: The meeting’s endpoint shifts forward to the exact hour.

findings.governingReading: cod hot pot with grated daikon
findings.explanation: The named dish loses grated daikon and becomes malformed English.

findings.governingReading: our household is about to have dinner
findings.explanation: The reason Rin’s relaxation is presumptuous is that the household is about to eat; English turns it into collective food preparation.

findings.evidenceJa: 夕飯をご馳走になった後
findings.governingReading: after you treat me to dinner
findings.explanation: Rin’s brazen assumption that Shirou will host and feed her becomes a neutral shared meal.

findings.highlight: letting Caster do whatever she wants for a while
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターに関してはしばらく放置
findings.governingReading: leaving Caster alone for the time being
findings.explanation: Rin’s manipulative binary concerns postponing action against Caster; English expands it to affirmative permission for anything Caster wants.

findings.highlight: Speaks with an expression of triumph
findings.evidenceJa: なんて、勝ち誇った顔で言いやがった
findings.governingReading: she says with a triumphant look
findings.explanation: The English is a sentence fragment and loses Shirou’s irritated evaluation of her delivery.
